description: From the summit terrace of Lycabettus beside the chapel of Agios Georgios, looking southwest, the chapel is at the left, the city lights fill the slope, and the warm-lit Acropolis sits in the middle distance with the Saronic Gulf beyond. The Open-Meteo cell is clear, about 11.8°C. The chapel itself is not floodlit.
